editor.title: Update your site yourself — no developer needed.
editor.body: Every site comes with a clean, simple editor. Click what you want to change, type, publish. No complicated dashboards, no waiting on me for a text change.

contact.title: Let's talk about your site.

whatIDo.title: I understand your brand first
whatIDo.body: Before anything is designed, I learn how your brand communicates and who you're speaking to. The site follows from that — not the other way around.

whatIDo.title: Fast, modern, clean code
whatIDo.body: Every site is built to be quick, reliable, and easy to maintain. No bloated templates, no page-builder clutter.

whatIDo.title: You manage it yourself
whatIDo.body: After delivery you edit your own text and images through a simple editor — no developer needed for everyday changes.

whatIDo.title: I stay available
whatIDo.body: For anything beyond content edits, I'm here. You're never left figuring it out alone.

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.body: We talk through your business, your audience, and what the site needs to do.

steps.title: I design and build
steps.body: I translate your brand into a fast, custom website — and keep you in the loop as it takes shape.

steps.title: You get your editor
steps.body: On handover I show you your CMS. Changing text and images takes minutes, not a support ticket.

steps.title: You run it, I support
steps.body: You manage day-to-day content. I'm available for everything beyond that.

serviceStages.title: Discovery & brand understanding
serviceStages.body: We start with a conversation, not a template. I want to understand what your business does, who it's for, and how it should feel. I look at how your brand already communicates and where a website can do more. You come away with a clear picture of what we're building and why.

serviceStages.title: Design
serviceStages.body: I design from first principles around your content and your audience — layout, typography, and tone that fit you specifically. You see the direction early and we refine together. Nothing decorative for its own sake; every choice earns its place.

serviceStages.title: Development & delivery
serviceStages.body: I build the site with clean, modern code — fast to load, reliable, and responsive on every screen. No bloated page builders. When it's ready, it's genuinely ready: tested, polished, and live on your domain.

serviceStages.title: CMS handover & training
serviceStages.body: On delivery I walk you through your editor. You'll be able to change text and swap images on your own in minutes — click the thing you want to change, edit it, publish. I make sure you're comfortable before we wrap.

serviceStages.title: Ongoing support
serviceStages.body: Content edits are always yours to make. Beyond that, support depends on your plan: Starter and Standard cover the site and hosting (Standard adds an hour of changes a month), while Pro gives you a direct line to me for anything more — new sections, integrations, or just advice.
